## Orchestrator model (Cursor)

Preferred session model for this command: `composer-2.5-fast` (tier `mid` via `home/agents/model-map.yaml`). Cursor slash commands inherit the chat model — switch the model picker to that pin before invoking if the session is on a stronger tier. Subagents keep their own frontmatter pins.

## Arguments (Cursor)

Positional args from the slash invocation: `$1`, `$2`, `$3`, … .
When this prompt mentions `$ARGUMENTS`, treat it as the joined remainder
`"$1 $2 $3 …"` (trim; empty if no args). Multi-token parsers (e.g. `/dispatch`)
still apply: `$1` = first token (key), later tokens / flags as documented below.


Wrap up the work on the current branch and hand it off to a PR. This is the
manual re-entry point into the spine when the work was done outside `/dispatch`
(e.g. a free-form debugging or investigation session). It behaves like `/land`
but carries an explicit "finish and open the PR" intent, so the user does not
need to remember `/land` → `/open-pr` separately.

## 1. Pre-flight (read-only)

- Resolve the current repo and branch.
- Determine the base branch: the first non-flag token in `$ARGUMENTS` if given,
  else the repo default (`gh repo view --json defaultBranchRef -q
  .defaultBranchRef.name`).
- Refuse (and say why) if you are on the repo's default branch and there is no
  uncommitted or unpushed work — there is nothing to wrap up.
- Extract a Jira key from the branch name if it follows the `<KEY>-...`
  convention (e.g. `ECW-1231-...`). Hold it for any Jira transition.

## 2. Mode selection

- If `--ship` is in `$ARGUMENTS`, treat this as **mode B** (pre-authorized) for
  this wrap-up only — deterministic gates auto-approve and the run stops only
  at judgment calls (see [`~/protocols/HANDOFF-PROTOCOL.md`](~/protocols/HANDOFF-PROTOCOL.md)).
- Otherwise, use **mode A** (default): auto-chain through the spine, but pause
  at the `/land` commit preview for a one-word `go`.

`/wrap-up` is a standalone entry point, so it carries its own mode into the
spine; it does not inherit a mode from a previous `/dispatch`.

## 3. Enter the spine at `/land`

- Forward the base branch to `/land`.
- Under mode B, also pass `--yes` so `/land` skips its commit preview and
  proceeds straight to commit + handoff to `/open-pr`.
- Under mode A, do **not** pass `--yes`; `/land` pauses at its commit preview,
  then auto-advances to `/open-pr` after the user says `go`.

`/land` already branches on whether a PR exists: none → `ADVANCE → /open-pr`,
existing PR → push and `ADVANCE → /babysit-pr`. `/open-pr` then opens the PR,
fires the In-Review Jira transition per the protocol, and starts
`/babysit-pr`.

## 4. Report

Report what you did: mode selected, branch/base, whether you advanced to
`/land` or halted, and the reason if you halted. If the branch has no work to
land or `/land` returned `HALT`, surface it honestly rather than forcing the
next step.

`ADVANCE → /land` on success; `HALT: <reason>` if the branch is unlandable or
`/land` halted.
